name: color-picker
title: Color Picker
description: An outline button showing the current colour opens a panel with a saturation-lightness square, a rainbow hue slider, an editable colour value and twelve preset dots.
use: Users pick a brand or theme colour and need both presets and fine HSL control.
avoid: It is a compact button-plus-panel and needs the separate popover, button, input and label parts installed.
a11y: The saturation-lightness square is a click-only div, so keyboard users cannot pick a colour there; presets have no group label. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small dark pill shows a round colour dot, an hsl value and a chevron. Opened, a dark card sits above with a bright gradient square, a slim rainbow strip, a value field and two rows of round preset colours.
behaves: Clicking the swatch opens the panel with a quick scale; dragging in the square or along the hue strip updates the chosen colour live, and any preset applies instantly with a tick.
customise: color and onChange are the only props; the presets, panel width and slider styling are hardcoded in the source.
weight: light: One popover and a handful of preset buttons; motion only while open or hovered.
demo: Blue starting colour, the value hsl(211, 100%, 50%) and a Selected readout below.
issues: The colour square is a div with a click handler only, so it cannot be used from the keyboard.
Preset swatches have no accessible labels beyond their colour.
Long colour strings are cut with an ellipsis in the trigger, hiding the exact value.
polishWhy: Cohesive dark picker with live preview and presets; the mouse-only colour square is the weak spot.
